list.emptyDescription: This is where you keep your passwords and notes. They are encrypted on this device before they leave it: not even we can read them. You can share them with whoever you choose.
list.noResultsSearch: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try another name, username, website or tag.
list.noResultsFilter: There are no items in this filter.
list.selectDescription: Select an item from the list to see its details, copy them or share it.
list.invitationsHint: Someone wants to share with you. Open them to accept or decline.

detail.notFoundTitle: This item is no longer in your vault
detail.notFoundDescription: You may have deleted it on another device, or it is no longer shared with you.
detail.totpInvalid: The code cannot be calculated from the saved key. Edit the item and paste it again.
detail.siteNotOpenable: This address is not a website (http or https), so we do not open it from here. You can copy it.
detail.openFailed: The browser could not be opened. Copy the address and open it yourself.
detail.historyDescription: The last {count} this item has had, in case you need to go back to one.
detail.historyDescriptionOne: The password this item had before, in case you need to go back to it.
detail.pendingOffline: The last change is saved on this device. It will be sent by itself when the connection is back.
detail.syncErrorTitle: This item has not been synced
detail.sharingPrivate: Only you can see this item. You can share it with other AccioPass users: if you change it, theirs updates by itself.

sharingByMe.one: You share it with {count} person. If you change it, theirs updates by itself.
sharingByMe.other: You share it with {count} people. If you change it, theirs updates by itself.

detail.sharingByMeNobody: It is ready to share, but right now nobody else has access.
detail.sharingWithMeViewer: {email} shares it with you. You can view and copy it, but not change it. If {email} changes it, it updates here by itself.
detail.sharingWithMeEditor: {email} shares it with you and lets you edit it. What you change updates for everyone with access.
detail.deleteMessage: It will be deleted from your vault on all your devices. This cannot be undone.

deleteSharedMessage.one: It will be deleted from your vault and from that of the person you share it with. This cannot be undone. What they have already seen, they know: if it is a password, change it on the service.
deleteSharedMessage.other: It will be deleted from your vault and from those of the {count} people you share it with. This cannot be undone. What they have already seen, they know: if it is a password, change it on the service.

detail.deleteSharedOffline: Deleting a shared item needs a connection: it has to be withdrawn from the others too.
detail.leaveMessage: It will disappear from your vault. The others keep it, and {email} can invite you again.
detail.leaveOffline: Leaving a shared item needs a connection.
detail.left: You no longer have this item

leaked.title: Leaked password

body.one: This password appears {times} time in known breaches. Anyone holding those lists can try it.
body.other: This password appears {times} times in known breaches. Anyone holding those lists can try it.

leaked.bodyUnknownCount: This password appears in known breaches. Anyone holding those lists can try it.
leaked.todo: Change it on the service for a generated one and save the new one here.
leaked.todoViewer: Tell {email} so they change it on the service.

weak.title: Weak password
weak.body: It is short or easy to guess: an attacker would find it quickly.
weak.todo: Change it on the service for a generated one: long, random and different from the rest.
weak.todoViewer: Tell {email} so they change it for a longer one.

reused.title: Reused password
reused.body: You use this same password in another item. If it leaks on one site, it opens the other.
reused.todo: Use a different password for each service.
reused.todoViewer: Tell {email}: each service should have its own.

insecureUrl.title: Unencrypted site
insecureUrl.body: One of the addresses starts with http://. The password would travel unencrypted when used there.
insecureUrl.todo: Check whether the site works with https:// and correct the address.
insecureUrl.todoViewer: Tell {email} so they check the address.

old.title: Old password
old.body: It has not changed for more than a year.
old.todo: If the service matters, renew it when you can.

no2fa.title: No two-step verification
no2fa.body: This service lets you add a second step when signing in and there is no code saved for it here.
no2fa.todo: Turn it on at the service and add the code to this item from “Edit”.

form.name: Name
form.nameRequired: Give it a name so you can find it later.
form.tooLong: It is too long. Shorten it a little.
form.passwordHint: Type it or generate a new one with the dice.
form.breachChecking: Checking whether it appears in breaches…
form.breachClean: It does not appear in known breaches.

breachFound.one: It appears {times} time in known breaches. We recommend using another one; you can generate one with the dice.
breachFound.other: It appears {times} times in known breaches. We recommend using another one; you can generate one with the dice.

form.breachOffline: Without a connection we cannot check whether it has been leaked. We will when it is back.

breachConfirmMessage.one: It appears {times} time in known breaches, so it is among the first an attacker would try. You can save it anyway and change it later.
breachConfirmMessage.other: It appears {times} times in known breaches, so it is among the first an attacker would try. You can save it anyway and change it later.

form.urlInvalid: This does not look like a web address. Write it as example.com, with https in front if you like.
form.totpHint: If the service uses two-step verification, paste here the key it shows next to the QR code. You will see the code on this item.
form.totpInvalid: This is not a valid key. Paste the key as the service shows it, or the whole otpauth:// link.
form.totpUnsupported: Only codes that change over time (TOTP) can be attached here. Save this one in the Codes section.
form.totpReady: Valid key. The code will appear on the item once saved.
form.totpAttached: This item already has a verification code.
form.totpReplaceHint: Paste a new key only if you want to replace the current one.
form.totpRemoved: The code will be removed when you save.
form.tagsHint: Press Enter or type a comma to add.
form.favoriteDescription: Favourites come first in the list.
form.noteTitleRequired: Give it a title so you can find it later.
form.noteContentPlaceholder: What you write here is stored encrypted.
form.savedOffline: Saved on this device. It will sync when the connection is back.
form.fixProblems: Check the marked fields before saving.
form.discardMessage: What you have written has not been saved.

sharedNotice.one: This item is shared. When you save, the change also reaches the other person.
sharedNotice.other: This item is shared. When you save, the change also reaches the other {count} people.

form.sharedNoticeMember: This item belongs to {email}. When you save, the change reaches everyone with access.
form.readOnly: This item is read only for you: {email} shares it with you without permission to edit.

ai.hint: The assistant only receives the name and the website (without the path) of this item. Never the username or the password.
ai.nothing: There is nothing new to suggest for this item.
ai.unavailable: No suggestion is available right now.

generator.title: Generate password
generator.description: It is made on this device with cryptographic randomness. It is not sent anywhere.
generator.excludeAmbiguousHint: No 0 and O, nor 1, l and I.
generator.capitalize: Start each word with a capital
generator.replaceHint: It will replace the password typed in the form.

invalid.classes: Turn on at least one type of character.
invalid.other: Nothing can be generated with these settings. Change one of them.
